steps.tx: **Soil-transmitted worms** (ascaris, hookworm, whipworm) stunt growth and anaemise kids; **strongyloides autoinfects** lifelong. **Filaria blocks lymphatics** to elephantiasis; **schistosomes bleed bladders** and fibrose livers. **Pork tapeworm seeds brain cysts**; hydatid cysts burst fatally. **Single-dose albendazole deworms** masses; **stool microscopy diagnoses** most. **Eosinophilia with high IgE** flags tissue migrants.

steps.tx: **Barefoot soil** invites hookworm larvae; **faecal food** carries ascaris eggs. **Pork with beef** carry tapeworms; **watercress with fish** carry flukes. **Mosquitoes seed filaria** at night; **snails release schistosome** cercariae into water. **Autoinfection keeps strongyloides** decades after travel. **Pig-human cysticercosis** spreads without pork via dirty hands.

steps.tx: **Ascaris balls obstruct** ileum and wander into bile ducts causing cholangitis. **Hookworm sucks blood** causing iron deficiency with ground itch and cough (Loeffler). **Whipworm dysentery with rectal prolapse** strikes heavy loads. **Threadworm itches anuses** at night; **tape-measure stools** tape parents. **Deworm before complications**; obstruction needs surgical watch.

steps.tx: **Larva currens races** buttocks and thighs in strongyloidiasis. **Steroids or HTLV trigger hyperinfection** with Gram-negative sepsis and meningitis. **Disseminated larvae reach everywhere**; mortality nears total without rapid ivermectin. **Eosinophilia may vanish** in hyperinfection, misleading. **Screen before steroids** in migrants with eosinophilia. **Chronic diarrhoea with wheeze** in ex-travellers suggests it.

steps.tx: **Hydrocele with elephantiasis** marks chronic filariasis; **acute adenolymphangitis** burns red streaks. **Tropical pulmonary eosinophilia** wheezes at night with massive eosinophils. **Microfilariae circulate at night**; day blood misses them. **DEC provocation** unmasks hidden loads. **Lymphoedema needs hygiene** with antibiotics for entry lesions; **surgery debulks** late elephantiasis rarely.

steps.tx: **Katayama fever** (serum sickness-like) opens acute schistosomiasis weeks after water. **Terminal haematuria** marks S. haematobium; **bladder cancer follows** chronicity. **Bloody dysentery with periportal fibrosis** marks mansoni and japonicum. **Swimmer's itch** warns at exposure. **Portal hypertension bleeds varices** while liver function stays normal. **Genital schisto** causes infertility and hematuria.

steps.tx: **Cysticercosis causes adult-onset seizures** with calcified grains on CT; **racemose basal cysts** hydrocephalus. **Hydatid liver cysts** grow silently; rupture anaphylaxes. **Pork tapeworm carriers** seed household cysticercosis. **Neurocysticercosis needs imaging plus serology**; single enhancing lesions confuse with TB. **Ocular cysts never get anthelminthics alone**; surgical referral decides.

steps.tx: **Three stools on alternate days** catch intermittent shedding; **agar culture** grows strongyloides. **Midnight blood films** catch filaria; **antigen ICT works day or night**. **Urine midday sample** finds haematobium eggs; **stool Kato-Katz** quantifies others. **Tape test at dawn** catches threadworm. **Serology stays positive** after cure; use for migrants. **Eosinophils guide** but vanish in hyperinfection and filarial elephantiasis.

steps.tx: **Albendazole 400 mg once** cures ascaris; **mebendazole 500 mg once or 100 mg twice daily 3 days** alternates. **Hookworm takes albendazole 400 mg daily 3 days**. **Strongyloides takes ivermectin 200 micrograms per kilo daily 2 days**, 14 days past negative stools if disseminated. **DEC 6 mg/kg daily 12 days** treats active filaria; **MDA uses single-dose triple therapy**. **Praziquantel 40 mg/kg once** (mansoni, haematobium) or 60 mg/kg (japonicum) cures schisto. **Cysticercosis takes albendazole 15 mg/kg with steroids**; hydatid needs surgery plus albendazole.
steps.say: Albendazole four hundred milligrams once was reported to cure ascaris, while mebendazole five hundred milligrams once or one hundred twice daily for three days alternated. Hookworm was reported to take albendazole four hundred milligrams daily for three days. Strongyloides was reported to take ivermectin two hundred micrograms per kilo daily for two days, and fourteen days past negative stools if disseminated. D E C six milligrams per kilo daily for twelve days was reported to treat active filaria, while M D A used single-dose triple therapy. Praziquantel forty milligrams per kilo once or sixty for japonicum was reported to cure schisto. Cysticercosis was reported to take albendazole fifteen milligrams per kilo with steroids, while hydatid needed surgery plus albendazole.

steps.tx: **Exam traps:** single stool misses most worms; three samples decide. **Treating elephantiasis with DEC alone** misses bacterial superinfection care. **Steroids before excluding strongyloides** kills migrants. **Praziquantel in pregnancy** waits (except severe schisto); **albendazole in first trimester** avoids unless heavy harm outweighs. **Killing cysticerci without steroids** swells brains fatally. **Hydatid aspiration without surgery** anaphylaxes.
